an4.127:1.1: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā pātubhavanti.
an4.127:1.3: Yadā bhikkhave bodhisatto Tusitā kāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātukucchiyaṃ okkamati atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvanaṃ.
an4.127:1.4: Yā pi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā yattha p' imesaṃ candimasuriyānaṃ evaṃ mahiddhikānaṃ evaṃ mahānubhāvanaṃ ābhā nānubhonti, tattha pi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvanaṃ.
an4.127:1.5: Ye pi tattha sattā uppannā te pi ten' obhāsena aññamaññaṃ sañjānanti--aññe
an4.127:1.6: pi kira bho santi sattā idh' uppannā ti
an4.127:1.7: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati. 2.
an4.127:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yadā bodhisatto sato sampajāno mātu kucchismā nikkhamati atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvanaṃ.
an4.127:2.2: Yā pi tā lokantarikā . . . tattha pi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvanaṃ
an4.127:2.5: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati. 3.
an4.127:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yadā Tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati atha sadevake loke . . . pe . . . [127.2] . . .
an4.127:3.5: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati. 4.
an4.127:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yadā Tathāgato anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavatteti atha sadevake loke . . . [127.2] . . . idh'
an4.127:4.5: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.
an4.127:4.6: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ime cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā pātubhavantīti. 128. 1.
